title: Page 125
transc:
think the laws torch Ridge must exceed ours
but this is only a guess based up
on the fact that they oiled and were
warmer so after unity I wish you would
send me all the sutton you have of
Knapsack by Bull Run and also care Knave
Pekin send by way of Bull run all
Sweden Saxon Bergen Roman Zebra at present we
can claim no victory tower rose neither have
they gained a single advantage pedlar Rockland pushed
out of their seymour to prevent their venus
being turned & have been sooner or later
driven back in every instance zebra up to
this hour Rome have not shown them selves
in saint with in a spoon of our
line yoke Juno think well fetch em today
384 W govt Duplicate  SH Beckwith


Wash'n May 14th 1864
R OBrien Hd Qrs Gen Butler 
snake opal attica may fever via
grapes for Italy zebra please wrangle
Knox to have the Galway &
blossom welch cut if possible Jersey
Eckert
